_meta.why: All Homey apps in this project (Universal, Stable, Bastien house) are local-first by default — Zigbee mesh + WiFi LAN before any cloud. Cloud is optional pairing/key export only, never control path of record.

never: Require Tuya cloud account for Zigbee RX/TX
Cloud re-login after Homey reboot for day-to-day control
Homey runtime paid/remote AI for device control
Force Zigbee end-devices through WiFi hub LAN when Homey mesh works

apps.com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee: Universal — local Zigbee + optional WiFi LAN
apps.com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee.bastien: Bastien house — local Zigbee only on Bastien Pro

zigbee.path: Homey Pro coordinator ↔ device (ZCL / EF00) — zero Tuya cloud
zigbee.invariant: No TuyaCloudAPI / openapi.tuya* required for Zigbee onNodeInit / capability TX

wifiLan.path: Homey ↔ device TCP 6668 + UDP discovery; device_id + local_key in settings/store

homeyRuntimeAi.policy: zero cloud AI on Homey box — LocalSelfImproveCatalog / LocalFirstEngine only

controlPathDoctrine.zigbeeEndDeviceHomey: Primary — pair to Homey Zigbee, no local_key
controlPathDoctrine.wifiLan: Primary for WiFi SKUs — tuyapi + local_key
controlPathDoctrine.zigbeeBehindTuyaHub: Fallback only — gwID + cid, limited LAN sessions

agentChecklist: Prefer Homey Zigbee mesh over hub LAN for Zigbee SKUs
WiFi: persist device_id+local_key; cloudFallback stays false unless user opts in
Never invent cloud-required pairing for Zigbee
Cite OSS LAN peers as data sources — control stays local
Homey runtime: no remote AI for device IO
